triggering_diagnosis.finding: R/K optimization passed, but on-path answer preference and all free-generation stance checks failed.

objective: Test whether an explicit, inspectable K-to-language bridge resolves the communication bottleneck without assigning task relevance to Stage1 UQ or adding direct control.

task_risk_language_bridge.pass_1: ORION visual tokens plus route text and 600 U-independent spatial relevance queries predict R.
task_risk_language_bridge.pass_2: ORION visual tokens plus 600 Stage1-UQ tokens plus compact K bridge tokens generate QA text.
task_risk_language_bridge.bridge_layout: six view tokens plus one global token
task_risk_language_bridge.zero_uq_contract: Bridge output is independent of R when U is identically zero.

sampling.method: oversample each target stance to the majority count; every non-driving record remains once per epoch

evaluation_gates: language NLL and dense R BCE improve
on-path K exceeds matched off-path K by at least 0.2
zero-UQ and off-path target answers outrank the matched conservative answer
on-path target answer outranks the matched maintain answer
free generation is maintain for zero-UQ and off-path
free generation matches the conservative target stance for on-path
stop_policy: No GPU launch until the two-pass entry point passes interface preflight and an explicit single-run amendment is activated. Failure of the bridge smoke pauses Route196 overfit iterations for architecture review.
claim_boundary: One-event architecture learnability test only; no held-out generalization, trajectory, closed-loop, or safety evidence.
